summary: Create new world screen appears even when world is created; clicking on button causes freeze or crash
description: The bug I just created a new world to test out the new features, but the game froze for a second after I enabled the 1.20 data pack. When I clicked on continue, nothing happened until the game unfreeze. But the create world button is in the same place as the continue button. So when the world loaded up, I was met with the create new world screen again. When I created a world again, it got stuck on preparing world for creation Steps to reproduce - Create World Tab - Experiments - Double click on Done - Now, you will get two buttons, if you click Create New World game will softlock
Steps to Reproduce: Create World Tab - Experiments - Double click on Done - Now, you will get two buttons, if you click Create New World game will softlock
Observed Behavior: the game froze for a second after I enabled the 1.20 data pack and got stuck on preparing world for creation
Expected Behavior: nothing happened until the game unfreeze
